<h2>Read sjSDM Tier Survivor Decisions</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Reads one round's survivor decisions from the isolated tier-tuning store
and selects the rows matching one unit model context. Missing, malformed,
or ambiguous evidence aborts so unit pipelines cannot prune locally.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>load_sjsdm_tier_survivor_decisions(
  store_path = NULL,
  data_model_context = NULL,
  round_id = NULL,
  read_target_function = targets::tar_read_raw
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="store_path">store_path</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character scalar path to the dedicated tier-tuning targets store.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_model_context">data_model_context</code></td>
<td>
<p>One-row model-context table.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="round_id">round_id</code></td>
<td>
<p>Positive integer identifier of the completed tier tuning round.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="read_target_function">read_target_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable target reader. Defaults to [targets::tar_read_raw()].</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Tier-wide decision tibble for the requested model context and round.
</p>

</main>
